meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AI 的记忆规则并验证生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望 AI 按你的规则记住重要信息并主动提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize your AI's memory rules and verify them live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to remember key info and alert you per your own rules

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会通过访谈了解你的工作,为你设计一套自定义笔记分类(观察类型和概念标签),在你批准后安装并激活到 claude-mem,可设置特定笔记的 Telegram 提醒,重启服务并确认新模式已生效。
howto.when: 当你要求定制 claude-mem 的记忆方式、创建或修改模式、添加笔记分类等,或想为特定记忆设置 Telegram 通知时触发,即使没说“mode”。

say.text: 帮我建一个记录法律案例笔记的模式,包含判例规则和考试陷阱。
say.note: Claude 会访谈你,设计观察类型和标签。

say.text: 我写代码时想记实验结论和线上事故,帮我定制一个模式。
say.note: Claude 会对照现有 code 模式,提议专属变体。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude interviews you about your work, designs a custom note taxonomy (observation types and concept tags), installs and activates it into claude-mem after you approve, optionally sets Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and verifies the mode appears in startup context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add note categories, or get Telegram notifications for certain memories, even if you don't say "mode".

say_en.text: Create a mode for law notes with case rules and exam traps.
say_en.note: Claude will interview you and design observation types and tags.

say_en.text: Add an observation type for client preferences and alert me on Telegram.
say_en.note: It will ask about your Telegram setup and configure alerts.

say_en.text: Customize a mode to track experiment outcomes and incidents.
say_en.note: It may suggest a variant of the standard code mode.
